ideas.shortAr: كل يوم ملكان يدعوان للي يعطي
ideas.shortEn: Every day two angels pray for the one who gives
ideas.benefitAr: ما من يوم يصبح العباد فيه إلا ملكان ينزلان، فيقول أحدهما: اللهم أعط منفقا خلفا.
ideas.benefitEn: Every day two angels come down. One says: O Allah, give the one who spends a replacement.
waysAr: ولو بريال، المهم تكون كل يوم.
حط حصالة صغيرة وتصدق باللي فيها آخر الأسبوع.
waysEn: Even one coin counts, as long as it is every day.
Keep a small box and give what is in it each week.

ideas.shortEn: Your body needs water all day long, from the morning to the night
ideas.benefitAr: الماء يساعدك تركز وتحس بنشاط أكثر.
ideas.benefitEn: Water helps you focus and feel more awake.
waysEn: Keep a bottle on your desk

ideas.benefitAr: كوبين في اليوم تكفي، والباقي يأخذ من نومك.
ideas.benefitEn: Two cups a day are enough; more takes from your sleep.

ideas.shortEn: A few pages open new doors
ideas.benefitEn: Reading grows what you know and calms your mind.
waysEn: Keep the book by your bed
